DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。散策について、何をご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to know about walking around?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 海が見える所で写真を撮りたいです。風が強いので、この道を進んでよいか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海が見える場所で写真を撮りたいが風が強いので、今見ている道を進んでよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to take photos somewhere with a sea view. The wind is strong, so I'd like to check whether I should continue along this path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want photos with a sea view but the wind is strong, and ask whether to continue on the path in front of you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の注意表示と通路の状況を確認してください。ご自身や同行者が歩きにくいほどの風ではありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the current warning signs and path conditions. Is the wind strong enough to make walking difficult for you or your companion?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同行者が帽子を押さえていて、立っているのも大変そうです。写真だけなら短時間だからよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同行者が帽子を押さえ立つのも大変そうだと説明し、撮影は短時間だから進んでもよいと思っていたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: My companion is holding their hat down and seems to be struggling even to stand. I thought taking photos would be okay because it would only be a short time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your companion is holding their hat and struggling to stand, and say you thought proceeding for a short photo stop would be okay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 短時間でも、歩行が難しい状況なら無理に進まないでください。撮影のために柵や通行制限を越えないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even briefly, don't force yourself onward if walking is difficult. Don't cross fences or access restrictions to take photos.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 海に近い道はやめます。風を避けて休める場所が使えるか、案内で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 海に近い道は進まず、風を避けて休める場所を利用できるか案内で確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't take the path near the sea. I'd like to check the guidance to see whether somewhere sheltered from the wind is available for resting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not continue near the sea and want to check whether a sheltered resting place is available. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 使える場所の案内を確認しましょう。別れて撮影を続けず、同行者と一緒に移動してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check the guidance for available places. Don't separate to keep taking photos; move together with your companion.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同行者も戻りたいと言っています。最初に通った案内板の所で一緒に経路を確認し、駐車場へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者も戻りたがっているので、最初に通った案内板で一緒に経路を確認して駐車場へ戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: My companion says they want to return too. We'll check the route together at the information board we first passed and return to the car park.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say your companion also wants to return, so you will check the route together at the first information board and return to the car park. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在地と戻る先を確認してください。風が弱まったように感じても、注意表示が変わったとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check your current location and where you're returning to. Even if the wind feels weaker, that doesn't necessarily mean the warning signs have changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 体感だけで制限解除と思わず、今の表示に従います。今日は写真を諦め、同行者と同じ経路で戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 風が弱く感じても制限解除とは考えず現在の表示に従い、今日は撮影を諦めて同行者と同じ経路で戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't assume restrictions are lifted just from how it feels; I'll follow the current signs. I'll give up taking photos today and return along the same route with my companion.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will follow current signs rather than assume restrictions are lifted when the wind feels weaker, give up photography today, and return by the same route with your companion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。無理な撮影を避け、足元に気をつけてお帰りください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Avoid forcing a photo opportunity and watch your footing on your way back. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。行き先について、何をお調べしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like me to look up about your destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 講習会に行きたいです。「交流センター」という名前だけメモしたのですが、美唄駅から歩けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 講習会の会場名だけメモしてきたので、駅から徒歩で行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to attend a course. I only noted the name 'Community Exchange Center.' Can I walk there from Bibai Station?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you only noted the course venue's name and ask whether it is within walking distance of the station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じような施設名があるかもしれません。主催者の案内に住所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: There may be facilities with similar names. Does the organizer's information give an address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あります。地図で見ていた所は別の町でした。こちらの住所を目的地にして、行き方を調べ直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 検索していた同名施設は別町で、主催者案内の住所を目的地にして調べ直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The place I was looking at on the map was in another town. I'd like to search again using this address as the destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the same-named facility you searched was in another town and you want to search again using the organizer's address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。会場名と住所を合わせましょう。受付の入口について記載はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Let's match the venue name with the address. Does it mention the reception entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「正面玄関」ではなく「参加者受付」の案内があります。会場の建物に着けばよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 建物の正面でなく参加者受付の入口指定があり、建物に着くだけでは足りないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: There's guidance for 'participant reception' rather than the 'main entrance.' I thought just reaching the venue building was enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the participant reception entrance is specified rather than the building's front, so reaching the building alone is not enough. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 主催者の図では参加者入口は北側で、正面玄関とは別です。この図の駅から北側入口までの徒歩目安は15分です。受付は何時ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The organizer's diagram shows the participant entrance on the north side, separate from the main entrance. This diagram estimates a fifteen-minute walk from the station to the north entrance. What time is registration?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受付は10時で、今は9時40分です。歩くと9時55分ごろで、余裕は5分ですね。道が不明なら途中で尋ねられるよう、案内図を持って歩きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付10時、現在9時40分、徒歩15分なら9時55分ごろで余裕5分と計算し、道を尋ねられるよう図を持って歩きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Registration is at 10:00, and it's now 9:40. Walking would get me there around 9:55, leaving five minutes. I'd like to walk with the map so I can ask along the way if I don't know the route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Calculate that registration at 10:00, now 9:40, and a fifteen-minute walk mean arrival around 9:55 with five minutes spare, and say you want to carry the diagram to ask directions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 計算はそのとおりです。これは案内図の目安なので、到着保証ではありません。北側入口へ向かう線をこちらで確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: That calculation is correct. This is the diagram's estimate, not a guaranteed arrival. We can check the line toward the north entrance here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 別町の同名施設ではなく、この案内図の北側入口へ歩きます。9時55分ごろは目安で余裕5分と理解し、図を持って出発します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別町の同名施設でなく案内図の北側入口へ徒歩で向かい、到着は9時55分ごろの目安で余裕5分と理解したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll walk to the north entrance on this diagram, not the same-named facility in another town. I understand 9:55 is an estimate with five minutes spare, and I'll set off with the diagram.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will walk to the diagram's north entrance rather than the other town's same-named facility, and understand the estimated 9:55 arrival and five-minute margin. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。案内の行き先を確かめてお出かけください。講習会、いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Check the destination in the instructions before setting off. Enjoy your course.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。証明書について、何をご相談されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about a certificate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子供の学校へ所得の書類を出します。今の年の証明書を頼めばよいか、提出先の紙を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 学校へ所得の書類を提出するため、今年の証明書でよいか提出先の指定を見てほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need to submit income documents to my child's school. Could you look at their instructions to see whether I should request this year's certificate?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you need income documents for school and ask for the recipient's requirements to be checked to see whether this year's certificate is correct. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 必要な年度と証明書名を確認しましょう。学校の指定はどこに書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the required fiscal year and certificate name. Where are the school's specifications written?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この欄です。年度と、所得があった年が別に書いてあります。どちらも今年の意味だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 指定欄の年度と所得の対象年が別で、両方とも今年だと思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: In this field. The fiscal year and the year the income was earned are written separately. I thought both meant this year.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the specified fiscal year and income year are separate, but you thought both meant the current year. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対象の年度を担当と確認してください。その期間に、今と違う市にお住まいだったことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please confirm the relevant fiscal year with the person in charge. Did you live in a different city during that period?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 去年は別の市に住んでいました。今の住所だけで申請先を決めず、どこの市へ頼むか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 去年は別市に住んでいたため、現在住所だけで申請先を決めず必要な自治体を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I lived in another city last year. I don't want to decide where to apply based only on my current address; I'd like to check which city to ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you lived in another city last year and want to check the appropriate municipality rather than choose solely by your current address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 申請先は証明書の種類や必要年度に合わせて確認します。学校の指定と、住所の履歴をお示しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check where to apply according to the certificate type and required fiscal year. Please show the school's requirements and your address history.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いつ引っ越したかを書いたメモがあります。学校が求めているのは私と妻の分なので、二人の申請条件も別に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 転居日のメモを示し、学校が求める自分と妻の二人分について申請条件を別々に聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a note of when I moved. The school needs documents for both me and my wife, so I'd like to ask separately about the application conditions for each of us.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the moving-date note and say you want separate application conditions for both you and your wife as requested by the school. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人と奥様の分をそれぞれ確認しましょう。代理で申請する場合の条件も担当にお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check your documents and your wife's separately. Please also ask the staff about the conditions for applying on another person's behalf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 証明書名、年度、所得の年、引っ越し日を整理します。二人分の申請先と代理条件がわかってから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 証明書名、年度、対象年、転居日を整理し、二人の申請先と代理条件を確認してから申し込むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll organize the certificate name, fiscal year, income year, and moving date. I'll apply once I know where to apply for each of us and the representative conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will organize the certificate name, fiscal year, income year, and moving date, and apply after confirming both application locations and representative conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。学校の案内とメモを持って担当へご相談ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring the school's instructions and your note to the person in charge. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受診の相談で、何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with your medical consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 階段を下りる時に膝が痛みます。左右を間違えないよう、症状を書いて持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 階段を下りる時に膝が痛むので、左右を間違えないよう症状のメモを持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My knee hurts when going down stairs. I've brought written symptoms so I don't mix up left and right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your knee hurts when descending stairs and you brought symptom notes to avoid confusing left and right. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 症状を担当へ伝えます。どちらの膝で、いつから痛みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll pass your symptoms to the staff. Which knee is it, and when did it start?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 左膝で、三日前からです。平らな道より、下りる時に痛みます。右ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 左膝で三日前から痛み、平地より階段の下りで痛むと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The left knee, since three days ago. It hurts more going down than on level ground. It's not the right knee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the left knee has hurt for three days, particularly when going downstairs rather than on flat ground. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 書いた内容も担当に見せてください。聞き取りが難しい言葉は、その場で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show your written details to the staff too. You can ask about any words that are difficult to understand as they come up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「いつも痛いですか」と聞かれたら、ずっとではなく動いた時と答えたいです。仕事中の階段でも痛むことを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 常時ではなく動いた時に痛み、職場の階段でも同じ症状があると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: If asked, 'Does it hurt all the time?', I'd like to answer that it isn't constant but happens when I move. I'll mention that the stairs at work hurt too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the pain is not constant but occurs with movement, including on the stairs at work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 痛む場面を具体的に説明してください。受診後の説明でも、わからない点は聞き返してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please explain specifically which situations cause pain. After the consultation, too, ask again about anything unclear in the explanations.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 診察で体の動かし方について説明を受けたら、自分の言葉で言い直して確認したいです。わかったふりをせず、「この理解で合っていますか」と聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 診察で動かし方の説明を受けたら自分の言葉で復唱し、理解が合うか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I'm given instructions on how to move my body during the consultation, I'd like to repeat them in my own words to check. Rather than pretend I understand, I'll ask, 'Is this understanding correct?'
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to repeat movement instructions from the consultation in your own words and check whether your understanding is correct. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのように、ご本人の理解を担当に確認してください。仕事で必要な動作も忘れずに伝えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check your own understanding with the staff that way. Don't forget to mention the movements you need to make at work too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 左膝、三日前、階段を下りる時の痛みを説明します。仕事の動作も伝え、説明を復唱して確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 左膝、発症時期、下りの動作と仕事での症状を示し、説明を復唱して確かめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain the left knee, three days ago, and pain when going downstairs. I'll also describe work movements and repeat the explanation to confirm.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will give the left knee, onset, descending movement, and work symptoms, then repeat explanations to check them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。医療担当へご案内します。待つ間に症状が変わったらお知らせください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll direct you to medical staff. If your symptoms change while waiting, let us know. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのような連絡でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What kind of message is causing you trouble?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知らない相手から、今日中に料金を払わないと困るというメッセージが来ました。返事をする前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知らない相手から当日中の支払要求が来て不安なので、返信前に相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: An unknown sender messaged saying I'd be in trouble unless I paid a charge today. I'd like advice before replying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say an unknown sender demanded payment today and made you worried, so you want advice before replying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メッセージを保存していますか。相手のリンクを開いたり、情報を入力したりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you saved the message? Did you open their link or enter information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 画面は保存しました。リンクを開いて電話番号を入れましたが、支払いはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画面を保存しリンクに電話番号を入力したが、支払いはまだしていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I saved the screen. I opened the link and entered my phone number, but haven't paid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you saved the screen and entered your phone number at the link but have not paid yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入力した情報と、その後に来た連絡を確認しましょう。追加の入力や送金は進めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check what you entered and any contact since then. Don't enter anything more or proceed with sending money.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その後、認証番号のメールが届きました。番号はまだ相手に伝えていません。これ以上は入力せず止めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 認証番号のメールが届いたが番号は相手に未送信で、追加の入力を止めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I then received an email with a verification code. I haven't given that code to the sender. I'll stop without entering anything else.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you received a verification-code email but have not sent the code to the other person, and will stop further input. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 番号を伝えず、画面と時刻を残してください。被害の確認と相談先をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Don't share the code; keep the screen and times. We'll explain how to check for harm and where to seek advice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: メッセージを怖くて消したくなりましたが、保存します。電話番号は入力済み、認証番号と支払い情報は未送信と伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 怖くてもメッセージは保存し、電話番号は入力済み、認証番号と支払情報は未送信と区別して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I was scared and wanted to delete the message, but I'll keep it. I'll explain that my phone number was entered, while the verification code and payment information haven't been sent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will save the message despite fear and distinguish the entered phone number from the unsent verification code and payment information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その区別は重要です。利用するサービス側にも、必要な保護手続きを確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: That distinction matters. Please also check with the relevant service about any protective procedures needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 送信者、本文、時刻を残し、入力した情報だけ正確に説明します。相手には返信せず、案内された相談先で対応を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 送信者、本文、時刻と入力済みの範囲を示し、返信せず案内された窓口で対応を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep the sender, text, and times and accurately explain only the information I entered. I won't reply to the sender; I'll check what to do at the recommended advice service.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the sender, message, time, and extent of entered information, and say you will not reply but check next steps with the directed service. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。保存した画面を担当へお見せください。ご相談いただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please show the saved screen to the person in charge. Thank you for asking for advice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今渡した贈り物に、違うサイズの服を入れたことに気づきました。まだこちらにあるなら、箱を返していただけるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 渡したばかりの贈り物にサイズ違いの服を入れたので、箱がまだあるなら返してもらえるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I just realized I put the wrong-size clothes in the gift I handed over. If it's still here, I'd like to ask whether I can get the box back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you put the wrong-size clothes in the gift just handed over, and ask whether the box can be returned if it is still there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず受付の記録と箱を確認します。控えを見せていただけますか。カウンターの内側の箱には、ご自身で手を触れずにお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, we'll check the acceptance record and box. May I see your receipt? Please wait without touching boxes inside the counter yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらが控えです。姉宛ての箱で、青いテープを貼りました。子供用の服は百二十を頼まれたのに、百を入れてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控えを示し、姉宛てで青いテープの箱に、頼まれた百二十ではなく百の子供服を入れたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's the receipt. It's a box for my older sister with blue tape. She asked for children's clothes in size 120, but I put in size 100.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the receipt and explain that the blue-taped box for your older sister contains size-100 children's clothes instead of the requested size 120. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付記録では、箱はまだ運び出されていません。宛先と控えの番号を照合したうえで、担当者が返却を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The acceptance record says the box hasn't been taken away yet. After matching the destination and receipt number, staff will check its return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 姉にはもう送ったと連絡しましたが、受け取る服を取り替えたいと伝えます。箱が戻るまで、別の荷物を追加で送るのは待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 姉へサイズ違いと取り替えの希望を伝え、元の箱が戻るまでは別の荷物を追加発送せず待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I already told my sister I'd sent it, but I'll explain I want to replace the clothes she'll receive. I'll wait without sending another parcel until the original box is returned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will tell your sister about the wrong size and replacement request, and wait without sending an extra parcel until the original box returns. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 控えの番号と宛先が箱の表示に一致しました。担当者から、この箱を返却する確認が取れました。青いテープもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The receipt number and destination match the box's label. Staff have confirmed this box can be returned. Please check the blue tape too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、私の箱です。こちらで受け取ったことを確認してから、家で服のタグを見直します。受付済みという連絡も、姉に訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返却する箱は自分の物だと確認し、受取り後に家でタグを見直して、姉へ受付済みと知らせた内容も訂正すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, it's my box. After confirming I've received it here, I'll check the clothing tags again at home. I'll also correct what I told my sister about its being accepted for shipping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the returned box is yours, and say you will check the tags at home after receiving it and correct your sister's information that it had been accepted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では箱をお返しします。今回はこの荷物を運搬へ回しません。再度送るときは、中身と表示を準備して新たに受付へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll return the box now. We won't send this parcel on for transport this time. When sending again, prepare the contents and labels and bring it for new acceptance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 箱を受け取りました。姉に今の発送は取りやめたと伝え、百二十の服へ入れ替えます。確認が済んでから改めて持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱を受け取ったことを伝え、姉に今回の発送取りやめを知らせ、百二十の服へ入れ替えて確認後に改めて持参すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received the box. I'll tell my sister this shipment was canceled and replace the clothes with size 120. I'll bring it again once I've checked everything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you received the box, will tell your sister this shipment was canceled, replace the clothes with size 120, and bring it again after checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。取り違えに気づけてよかったですね。箱をお忘れなく。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. It's good you noticed the mix-up. Don't forget your box. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。送金について、どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about sending money?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 海外の家族へ送金したいです。国内の振込で保存した名前を使えば、同じ操作で送れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海外の家族へ送金するため、国内振込に保存した名義で同じ操作が使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to send money to my family overseas. Can I use the name saved for a domestic transfer and send it with the same steps?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to send money to family overseas and ask whether you can use the same steps with an account name saved for domestic transfers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 国内振込と海外送金は、必要な情報や利用条件が異なります。送金先の国と目的を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Domestic transfers and international remittances have different information and usage requirements. Please tell me the destination country and purpose.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ベトナムにいる家族の生活費です。名前だけではなく、受取口座の情報も必要なんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 目的はベトナムの家族の生活費で、受取口座の情報も必要だと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Living expenses for my family in Vietnam. So I need the recipient account information, not just the name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the purpose is living expenses for family in Vietnam and confirm recipient account information is needed too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な受取情報と、当行で扱える方法を担当が確認します。受取人から案内をもらっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff will check the necessary recipient information and methods our bank handles. Have you received instructions from the recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 銀行名と口座の紙がありますが、英字の名前が身分証と同じか未確認です。家族に正式な表記を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 銀行と口座の資料はあるが英字名が身分証と一致するか未確認なので、本人に正式表記を尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have papers with the bank name and account, but haven't checked whether the name in Roman letters matches their ID. I'll ask my family for the official spelling.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have bank and account documents but have not confirmed the Roman-letter name matches identification, so will ask the recipient for the official spelling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当に必要な情報の一覧を確認してください。目的を示す書類や本人確認も、状況に応じてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask staff for a list of required information. We'll also explain purpose-verification documents and identification according to the circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 送る額と、家族が受け取る額が同じとは限らないので、手数料や換算を含めた説明を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 送金額と受取額が同じとは限らないため、手数料と換算を含めて説明してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The amount sent may differ from what my family receives, so I'd like an explanation including fees and currency conversion.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for an explanation including fees and currency conversion because the amount sent and received may differ. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その希望もお伝えします。手続き方法に応じた費用と表示を、確定前にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass on that request too. Please check the costs and displays for your chosen procedure before confirming.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 正式な受取情報と必要書類を揃えます。国内の登録をそのまま使わず、送金額、費用、受取額の説明を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正式な受取情報と必要書類をそろえ、国内登録をそのまま使わず確定前に金額と費用、受取額を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll gather the official recipient information and required documents. I won't use the domestic registration unchanged; I'll check the explanation of the amount sent, costs, and amount received.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will gather official recipient information and documents, not reuse domestic registration unchanged, and check the amounts and costs before confirming. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。海外送金の担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll direct you to the international remittance staff. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お会計で、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help at checkout?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 冷凍食品と洗剤を買います。バッグが一つしかないので、分けるための袋を一枚お願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷凍食品と洗剤を分けるため、追加の買い物袋を一枚頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm buying frozen food and detergent. I only have one bag, so could I have one more shopping bag to keep them separate?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request one extra shopping bag to separate frozen food and detergent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋の種類と料金をご案内します。冷凍食品の保冷は、お持ちのバッグで対応できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll explain the bag types and prices. Can your own bag keep the frozen food cold?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 保冷バッグはあります。そちらに食品を入れて、洗剤だけ別の袋にしたいです。袋を食品用に二枚買う必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 食品用の保冷バッグはあるので、洗剤用の袋だけ一枚ほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have an insulated bag. I'd like to put the food in that and only the detergent in another bag. I don't need to buy two bags for food.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have an insulated bag for food, so you need just one bag for detergent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分けて入れるご希望ですね。お支払いに使うものはお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You'd like to pack them separately, then. Have you decided how to pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このカードを使いたいですが、ポイントカードと一緒に持っています。先に提示するのがどちらか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 決済カードとポイントカードを持ち、どちらを先に提示するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to use this card, but I have it together with a points card. Please tell me which to show first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have a payment card and a points card, and ask which to present first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 先にポイントカードを提示してください。ポイントの確認が済んでから、対応する決済カードを使います。袋一枚の代金も合計に入れてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please present the points card first. Once points have been checked, use an accepted payment card. We'll include the price of one bag in the total too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: このカードで払えることを確認してから使います。袋代も入れた合計を見て、カードを決済の機械にかざします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カードが使えるかと袋代込みの合計を確認してから、案内に従って決済すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check that this card is accepted before using it. I'll check the total including the bag, then tap the card on the payment machine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check card acceptance and the bag-inclusive total, then pay according to the instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、案内が出てから操作してください。完了表示を確認するまでは、カードをすぐしまわないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please wait for the instructions before operating it. Don't put your card away immediately before checking the completion display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 食品は保冷バッグ、洗剤は購入した一枚の袋に入れます。ポイントと決済を分け、袋代込みの金額と完了を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食品と洗剤を別の袋にし、ポイントと決済を区別して袋代込みの金額と完了を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll put the food in the insulated bag and detergent in the one bag I bought. I'll distinguish points from payment and check the amount including the bag and completion.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will separate the food and detergent into different bags, distinguish points from payment, and check the bag-inclusive amount and completion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。商品を分けてお持ちください。ありがとうございました。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please carry the products separately. Thank you. Please visit again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。忘れ物について、どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about something left behind?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 水筒を忘れたかもしれません。似た物が休憩所にあったので、受け取る前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 休憩所に自分と似た水筒があるので、受取る前に持ち物か確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I may have left my water bottle behind. There's a similar one at the rest area, so I'd like to check before taking it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say there is a water bottle like yours at the rest area, and you want to check it belongs to you before collecting it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身の水筒の特徴と、最後に使った場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please describe your bottle and where you last used it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 白い水筒で、休憩所の机で使いました。同じ型を持つ人を見たので、色だけで自分の物とは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 白い同型の水筒を持つ人もいて、休憩所の机で使用したが色だけでは自分の物と判断できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's white, and I used it at the rest-area table. I saw someone with the same model, so I can't say it's mine from the color alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you used it at the rest-area table but saw someone with a matching white bottle, so color alone cannot identify it as yours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ほかに見分ける手がかりはありますか。中身や印など、担当が確認できることを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Are there any other identifying clues? Please tell us something staff can check, such as contents or markings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 底に小さい名前のシールがあります。正面から見えない印なので、担当の方にだけ書いて渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 底の記名シールは外から見えない印なので、担当者にだけ書いて示すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: There's a small name sticker on the bottom. Since it's a mark not visible from the front, I'll write it down and give it only to staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the name sticker on the bottom is not externally visible and you will write the information for staff only. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その情報で確認しましょう。休憩所を出てから、どこを歩かれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check using that information. Where did you walk after leaving the rest area?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 机を出て遊具の前を通り、こちらへ来ました。水筒をかばんへ入れた記憶は曖昧なので、かばんも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休憩所から遊具前を通った経路を伝え、収納の記憶は曖昧なのでかばんの中も確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I left the table, passed the playground equipment, and came here. I'm not sure I remember putting the bottle in my bag, so I'll check the bag too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the route past the equipment from the rest area and say your memory of packing the bottle is unclear, so you will check inside your bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: かばんの中と、歩いた場所を安全に確認してください。拾得物は、担当の確認が済んでから受け取りましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please safely check inside your bag and the places you walked. Collect the found item only after staff finish verifying it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 底の名前の印を示し、机から遊具前までの経路を伝えます。似ているだけの水筒を勝手に持ち帰らず、担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 底の印と歩いた経路で照合を頼み、似た水筒を勝手に持ち帰らず担当者の確認を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the name marking on the bottom and describe the route from the table past the equipment. I won't take a bottle home just because it looks similar; I'll have staff check it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for a match using the bottom marking and route, and say you will wait for staff verification without taking a similar bottle home yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。特徴を確認してご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01215-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check its features and guide you. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。交通の案内で、何をお調べしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What transport information would you like me to look up?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 列車が遅れていて、面接の開始に間に合わないかもしれません。今わかる運行情報を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 列車遅延で面接開始に間に合わない可能性があるため、現在の運行情報を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My train is delayed, and I may not make the start of my interview. Please tell me the current service information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say a train delay may make you late for your interview and ask for current service information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 利用予定の列車を確認します。面接先には、遅れる可能性を伝えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the train you're planning to use. Have you told the interview contact you may be late?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。交通が決まってから連絡するつもりでしたが、今の状況を先に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 面接先には未連絡で、交通が決まるのを待たず今の状況を先に知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I planned to contact them once transport was settled, but I'll tell them the current situation first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not contacted the interview location and will tell them the situation now without waiting for transport to be finalized. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確定していない時刻は、未定として伝えられます。別の交通を選ぶ場合も、現在使える方法を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can say a time is undetermined if it isn't confirmed. If choosing other transport, let's check what is currently available too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 面接先から、オンラインへの変更も相談できると返事が来ました。駅員さんに面接変更を頼むのではなく、先方と直接決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 面接先からオンライン変更の相談が可能との返事があり、変更は駅員でなく先方と直接決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The interview contact replied that we could also discuss switching online. I'll decide directly with them rather than ask station staff to change the interview.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the interview contact replied that an online switch can be discussed, and you will decide directly with them rather than station staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。交通の情報はこちらの案内で、面接の方法は先方で確認してください。移動するかも、その結果で判断できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Check transport information through our guidance and the interview arrangements with them. You can decide whether to travel based on that outcome too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先方に変更を確認している間、切符はまだ買い替えません。列車の更新情報を見られる案内を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 面接の変更を確認中は切符を買い替えず、列車情報の更新を確認する方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't replace my ticket yet while checking the interview change. Please tell me where I can see updated train information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not replace your ticket while checking the interview change, and ask how to check updated train information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 駅や事業者の最新案内をご確認ください。買い替える場合の切符の扱いも、購入元で別に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the latest station and operator information. Also separately check the ticket arrangements with the seller if replacing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 面接先と方法を決めてから、移動するか判断します。運行情報と切符の扱いを分けて確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 面接方法を先方と決めてから移動を判断し、運行情報と切符の取扱いを別に確かめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll decide whether to travel after agreeing on the interview format with them. I'll check the service information separately from ticket arrangements.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will agree on the interview format before deciding whether to travel, and check service information and ticket handling separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01216-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
